visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static portrait of a Neanderthal recreation in a museum setting; the figure is muscular with long hair and a beard, holding a wooden spear. Above him, bold text overlays are present. A man in a black shirt and glasses is partially visible at the bottom of the frame, gesturing with his hands. (2) The scene transitions to the man in the black shirt sitting at a table with several bowls of food, including cold noodles and soup. He speaks directly to the camera with high facial expressiveness and frequent hand gestures, often holding a black stylus. The background is a brightly lit indoor environment. (3) A graphic illustration is shown, featuring a large industrial pipe spraying a powerful jet of white water into a small cup of dark coffee, serving as a metaphor for genetic dilution. (4) The camera returns to the man in the black shirt as he continues his explanation. He uses his hands to indicate scale and movement. (5) A technical line graph appears on screen, showing three different decay curves on a coordinate plane with mathematical labels. (6) Back to the man, who continues to explain the 'Continent-Island Model' while gesturing. (7) Another graph is displayed, this time showing colored lines (red, black) mapping population changes over long periods of time (10,000 to 30,000 years). (8) The video concludes with the man speaking, ending with a close-up on his face as he looks upwards, followed by a final screen with a logo and social media handles.
